scenario: LGRA.2.9.6.8 — `emit` String-slot interpolation substitutes at runtime, and `{{`/`}}` escape to literal braces. r1 emits Step{argv} from Src{obj} with `"cc {s.obj} {{flag}}"`; r2 matches the Step and logs its argv. The log text proves `{s.obj}` substituted to the bound value and `{{flag}}` collapsed to the literal `{flag}` (the inner braces are data, not re-interpolated).
rules_ds:
schema Src scope logical:
    obj: String key

schema Step scope logical:
    argv: String key

rule r1:
    Src s
->
    emit Step logical argv: "cc {s.obj} {{flag}}"

rule r2:
    Step st
->
    log critical "{st.argv}"
